submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit of the optional fourth image when present, otherwise stylized-concept. Asset: ONE independent full-body 2D game animation sprite, frame 08/16 of RUN SE, genuine transparent RGBA background, native square image at least 1024 x 1024 (prefer current 1254 output), no contact sheet.
Input image 1 = exact character identity and anatomical handedness. Input image 2 = direction, fixed framing and body scale only (do not copy static feet). Input image 3 = primary approved painting style and rendering quality, never include its UI or other people. Optional input image 4 = EDIT TARGET, an already drawn run frame. Preserve its exact character scale, camera, face, painting and rigid qin. Redraw BOTH LEGS, hips, elbow counterrotation, cloth and hair to the requested DIFFERENT animation phase. This phase description must override the old pose in image4. Do not copy its old feet or knees.
Character: 天音少女, the exact round-faced large purple-eyed chibi musician, dark-purple high bun and long hair, lotus gold crown, white/lilac gold embroidered long sleeves, lavender bloomers and pale-violet gold shoes, green waist knot, pale translucent lavender ribbons, the same solid purple-gold long crescent-tipped stringed qin. Maintain all ornaments and scale.
View: Facing southeast, toward lower-right, front-right three-quarter view: her anatomical RIGHT shoulder/arm/leg is nearer camera on screen-left, anatomical LEFT on farther screen-right. Keep the reference SE view. Left hand stays on elevated neck toward screen-right, right hand at low strings on screen-left.
RUN phase: Late first flight: BOTH feet still clear of ground, LEFT foot reaching lower-right for contact, RIGHT knee folding closer behind, pelvis up 8 px and descending. Broad left-leading stride. Edit target image4: LEFT shin now unfolds further downward for next contact, foot forward-right x674 y925; RIGHT rear foot folds up x404 y824. Whole body descends 10 pixels from flight, neither toe grounded yet. No static standing.
This is an actual forward RUN with distinct alternating support, compression, passing, toe push, airborne and opposite-side landing. Both hands NEVER let go or switch: anatomical LEFT supports the upper neck, anatomical RIGHT holds lower soundboard/string region. Elbows and shoulders counter-rotate naturally against stepping hips while moving the held qin as one rigid mass. No free arm swing, no plucking gesture for running.
Maintain fixed orthographic/isometric camera, about 2.4 heads tall, same global body scale. Use virtual 1024 canvas with static ground/root at (512,942), approximately crown y=125 and average pelvis y=728; apply only the phase-specific small body bob, not independent fitting to canvas. Character stays centered around x512; full crown, hair, qin, trailing ribbon, two feet visible with generous margins. Preserve vertical airborne foot clearance. Shoes follow forward/back ground plane; do not glue lowest pixel to baseline. Do not resize different frames by bounding box.
Bright clean rounded polished Daoist Q-style hand-painting, refined soft volume, crisp colored outlines, warm gold details, same palette and completed finish as references. Neutral even light. No realism, plastic, tiny low-resolution sprite, duplicate limbs, switched hands, floating instrument, excessive glow, floor, shadows, particle/VFX, lettering, number, border or watermark. Produce only the single isolated character pose.
